                linear-gradient(rgba(0, 229, 200, 0.02) 1px, transparent 1px),
                linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0, 229, 200, 0.02) 1px, transparent 1px);
            background-size: 60px 60px;
            pointer-events: none;
            z-index: 0;
        }

        /* Gradient overlay for depth */
        .slide::after {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            background:
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 15% 85%, rgba(0, 229, 200, 0.08) 0%, transparent 50%),
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 85% 15%, rgba(255, 0, 128, 0.05) 0%, transparent 50%);
            pointer-events: none;
            z-index: 0;
        }

        .slide-content, .slide > *:not(.slide-number) {
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           TYPOGRAPHY
           =========================================== */
        h1 {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--title-size);
            font-weight: 700;
            line-height: 1.1;
            letter-spacing: -0.02em;
        }

        h2 {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--h2-size);
            font-weight: 600;
            line-height: 1.2;
            letter-spacing: -0.01em;
        }

        h3 {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--h3-size);
            font-weight: 500;
        }

        p, li, td, th {
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            line-height: 1.5;
        }

        .mono {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
        }

        .stat-number {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--stat-size);
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--accent-cyan);
            line-height: 1;
        }

        .stat-label {
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.1em;
            margin-top: 0.25em;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           ANIMATIONS
           =========================================== */
        .reveal {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateY(25px);
            transition: opacity var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out-expo),
                        transform var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out-expo);
        }

        .slide.visible .reveal {
            opacity: 1;
            transform: translateY(0);
        }

        .reveal:nth-child(1) { transition-delay: 0.05s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(2) { transition-delay: 0.12s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(3) { transition-delay: 0.19s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(4) { transition-delay: 0.26s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(5) { transition-delay: 0.33s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(6) { transition-delay: 0.40s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(7) { transition-delay: 0.47s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(8) { transition-delay: 0.54s; }

        .reveal-scale {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: scale(0.92);
            transition: opacity 0.5s var(--ease-out-expo),
                        transform 0.5s var(--ease-out-expo);
        }

        .slide.visible .reveal-scale {
            opacity: 1;
            transform: scale(1);
        }

        /* Bar chart grow animation */
        @keyframes barGrow {
            from { transform: scaleX(0); }
            to { transform: scaleX(1); }
        }

        .bar-fill {
            transform-origin: left center;
            animation: barGrow 0.8s var(--ease-out-expo) forwards;
        }

        .slide:not(.visible) .bar-fill {
            animation: none;
            transform: scaleX(0);
        }

        /* Donut chart rotation */
        @keyframes donutReveal {
            from { stroke-dashoffset: var(--circumference); }
            to { stroke-dashoffset: var(--offset); }
        }

        .donut-segment {
            animation: donutReveal 1s var(--ease-out-expo) forwards;
        }

        .slide:not(.visible) .donut-segment {
            animation: none;
        }

        /* Glow pulse */
        @keyframes glowPulse {
            0%, 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 20px var(--accent-cyan-glow); }
            50% { box-shadow: 0 0 40px var(--accent-cyan-glow), 0 0 60px rgba(0, 229, 200, 0.1); }
        }

        .glow-card {
            animation: glowPulse 3s ease-in-out infinite;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE NUMBER BADGE
           =========================================== */
        .slide-number {
            position: absolute;
            top: clamp(0.75rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            left: clamp(0.75rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--accent-cyan);
            opacity: 0.6;
            z-index: 10;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           PROGRESS BAR
           =========================================== */
        .progress-bar {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            height: 3px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-cyan), var(--accent-magenta));
            z-index: 9999;
            transition: width 0.3s ease;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           NAV DOTS
           =========================================== */
        .nav-dots {
            position: fixed;
            right: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1.5rem);
            top: 50%;
            transform: translateY(-50%);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 8px;
            z-index: 9999;
        }

        .nav-dot {
            width: 8px;
            height: 8px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
            border: none;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
            padding: 0;
        }

        .nav-dot.active {
            background: var(--accent-cyan);
            box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--accent-cyan-glow);
            transform: scale(1.3);
        }

        .nav-dot:hover {
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.5);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 1: TITLE SLIDE
           =========================================== */
        .title-slide {
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;
            text-align: center;
        }

        .title-slide .title-wrapper {
            max-width: min(85vw, 900px);
        }

        .title-slide h1 {
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.5rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
        }

        .title-slide h1 .accent {
            color: var(--accent-cyan);
            position: relative;
        }

        .title-slide h1 .accent::after {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            bottom: -2px;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 3px;
            background: var(--accent-cyan);
            box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--accent-cyan-glow);
        }

        .title-slide .subtitle {
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            font-size: clamp(0.8rem, 1.5vw, 1.15rem);
            margin-bottom: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2rem);
            line-height: 1.6;
        }

        .title-slide .data-badge {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.5em;
            padding: 0.5em 1.2em;
            border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 200, 0.3);
            border-radius: 100px;
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--accent-cyan);
            background: rgba(0, 229, 200, 0.05);
        }

        .title-slide .data-badge .dot {
            width: 6px;
            height: 6px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: var(--accent-cyan);
            animation: glowPulse 2s ease-in-out infinite;
            box-shadow: 0 0 6px var(--accent-cyan);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 2: PLATFORM OVERVIEW
           =========================================== */
        .stats-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: clamp(0.75rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            margin-top: clamp(0.75rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
        }

        .stat-card {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid rgba(0, 229, 200, 0.1);
            border-radius: 12px;
            padding: clamp(0.75rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            text-align: center;
            backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
        }

        .stat-card .stat-number {
            font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 3.5vw, 3rem);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 3: TOP 5 REPOS (HORIZONTAL BAR CHART)
           =========================================== */
        .ranked-bars {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
            margin-top: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
        }

        .rank-row {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 2.5rem 1fr auto;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1vw, 0.75rem);
        }

        .rank-num {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--accent-cyan);
            text-align: center;
            font-weight: 700;
        }

        .rank-label {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            min-width: 0;
        }

        .rank-label .repo-name {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(0.65rem, 1.2vw, 0.9rem);
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            white-space: nowrap;
            overflow: hidden;
            text-overflow: ellipsis;
        }

        .rank-label .repo-metrics {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: clamp(0.5rem, 0.8vw, 0.65rem);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            white-space: nowrap;
            overflow: hidden;
            text-overflow: ellipsis;
        }

        .rank-bar-container {
            width: 100%;
            height: clamp(20px, 3vh, 32px);
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03);
            border-radius: 6px;
            overflow: hidden;
            position: relative;
        }

        .rank-bar-fill {
            height: 100%;
            border-radius: 6px;
            transform-origin: left center;
            animation: barGrow 0.8s var(--ease-out-expo) forwards;
            position: relative;
        }

        .slide:not(.visible) .rank-bar-fill {
            animation: none;
            transform: scaleX(0);
        }

        .rank-bar-fill .bar-value {
            position: absolute;
            right: 8px;
            top: 50%;
            transform: translateY(-50%);
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(0.5rem, 0.9vw, 0.7rem);
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--bg-primary);
        }

        .rank-score {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: clamp(0.6rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
            color: var(--accent-cyan);
            font-weight: 700;
            min-width: 4ch;
            text-align: right;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 4: LANGUAGE DISTRIBUTION (DONUT CHART)
           =========================================== */
        .donut-layout {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 3rem);
            align-items: center;
            margin-top: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
        }

        .donut-chart-wrapper {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;
        }

        .donut-chart-wrapper svg {
            max-width: min(35vw, 300px);
            max-height: min(40vh, 280px);
        }

        .lang-legend {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.3rem, 0.8vw, 0.6rem);
        }

        .lang-legend-item {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 12px 1fr auto;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.3rem, 0.8vw, 0.6rem);
        }

        .lang-dot {
            width: 10px;
            height: 10px;
            border-radius: 3px;
        }

        .lang-name {
            font-size: clamp(0.6rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        .lang-count {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: clamp(0.55rem, 0.9vw, 0.75rem);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 5: CATEGORY BREAKDOWN (TREEMAP)
           =========================================== */
        .treemap-container {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 5fr 2fr 1.5fr 1.5fr;
            grid-template-rows: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: 4px;
            margin-top: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
            height: clamp(150px, 35vh, 280px);
        }

        .treemap-cell {
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: center;
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .treemap-cell .treemap-label {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(0.6rem, 1.1vw, 0.85rem);
            font-weight: 600;
            color: #fff;
        }

        .treemap-cell .treemap-count {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: clamp(0.5rem, 0.8vw, 0.65rem);
            color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7);
            margin-top: 2px;
        }

        .treemap-cell .treemap-pct {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(0.8rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            font-weight: 700;
            color: rgba(255,255,255,0.9);
            margin-top: 2px;
        }

        .tm-ai-agents {
            grid-row: 1 / 3;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #00b89c, #008f7a);
        }

        .tm-claude {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #a855f7, #7c3aed);
        }

        .tm-infra {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #3b82f6, #2563eb);
            grid-row: 1 / 3;
        }

        .tm-dev-utils {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f59e0b, #d97706);
            grid-row: 1 / 3;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 6: CLAUDE CODE ECOSYSTEM
           =========================================== */
        .ecosystem-layout {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
            margin-top: clamp(0.5rem, 1vw, 0.75rem);
        }

        .eco-core-row {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1vw, 0.75rem);
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }

        .eco-node {
            padding: clamp(0.3rem, 0.8vw, 0.6rem) clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
            border-radius: 8px;
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: clamp(0.5rem, 0.9vw, 0.72rem);
            font-weight: 500;
            text-align: center;
            white-space: nowrap;
            position: relative;
        }

        .eco-node-core {
            background: rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.15);
            border: 1px solid rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.4);
            color: #c084fc;
        }

        .eco-node-broader {
            background: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.12);
            border: 1px solid rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.3);
            color: #93c5fd;
        }

        .eco-hub {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;
        }

        .eco-hub-label {
            padding: clamp(0.4rem, 1vw, 0.8rem) clamp(1rem, 2vw, 2rem);
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.25), rgba(0, 229, 200, 0.15));
            border: 1.5px solid rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.5);
            border-radius: 12px;
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(0.7rem, 1.3vw, 1rem);
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--accent-cyan);
            text-align: center;
        }

        .eco-divider {
            width: 1px;
            height: clamp(15px, 3vh, 25px);
            background: linear-gradient(to bottom, var(--accent-cyan), transparent);
            margin: 0 auto;
        }

        .eco-label-row {
            text-align: center;
        }

        .eco-label-row .eco-section-label {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(0.55rem, 0.9vw, 0.7rem);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.15em;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 7: COMMUNITY ENGAGEMENT (GROUPED BARS)
           =========================================== */
        .engagement-chart {
            display: flex;
            align-items: flex-end;
            gap: clamp(0.3rem, 0.8vw, 0.6rem);
            margin-top: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
            height: clamp(180px, 35vh, 280px);
            padding-bottom: 2rem;
            position: relative;
        }

        .engagement-chart::after {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            bottom: 1.8rem;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            height: 1px;
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
        }

        .engage-group {
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 3px;
            position: relative;
        }

        .engage-bars {
            display: flex;
            gap: 2px;
            align-items: flex-end;
            height: 100%;
        }

        .engage-bar {
            width: clamp(8px, 1.2vw, 16px);
            border-radius: 3px 3px 0 0;
            transition: height 0.6s var(--ease-out-expo);
        }

        .engage-bar.prs {
            background: var(--accent-cyan);
        }

        .engage-bar.pushes {
            background: var(--accent-magenta);
        }

        .engage-label {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: clamp(0.4rem, 0.65vw, 0.55rem);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            position: absolute;
            bottom: -1.8rem;
            white-space: nowrap;
            text-align: center;
            transform: rotate(-25deg);
            transform-origin: top left;
        }

        .engage-legend {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2rem);
            margin-top: clamp(0.3rem, 0.8vw, 0.5rem);
        }

        .legend-item {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.4em;
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        .legend-swatch {
            width: 10px;
            height: 10px;
            border-radius: 2px;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 8: KEY TAKEAWAYS
           =========================================== */
        .takeaway-list {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vw, 0.9rem);
            margin-top: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
        }

        .takeaway-item {
            display: flex;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1vw, 0.75rem);
            align-items: flex-start;
            padding: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vw, 0.8rem) clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border-left: 3px solid var(--accent-cyan);
            border-radius: 0 8px 8px 0;
            backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
        }

        .takeaway-item:nth-child(2) { border-left-color: var(--accent-magenta); }
        .takeaway-item:nth-child(3) { border-left-color: var(--accent-orange); }
        .takeaway-item:nth-child(4) { border-left-color: var(--accent-blue); }
        .takeaway-item:nth-child(5) { border-left-color: var(--accent-purple); }

        .takeaway-icon {
            font-size: clamp(0.9rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            line-height: 1;
            flex-shrink: 0;
            margin-top: 2px;
        }

        .takeaway-text {
            font-size: clamp(0.6rem, 1.05vw, 0.8rem);
            line-height: 1.5;
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        .takeaway-text strong {
            color: var(--accent-cyan);
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SECTION HEADER (shared across content slides)
           =========================================== */
        .section-header {
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.3rem, 1vw, 0.75rem);
        }

        .section-header h2 {
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.2rem, 0.5vw, 0.3rem);
        }

        .section-header .section-sub {
            font-size: clamp(0.6rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.4;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           RESPONSIVE BREAKPOINTS
           =========================================== */
        @media (max-height: 700px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.75rem, 3vw, 2rem);
                --content-gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
                --title-size: clamp(1.25rem, 4.5vw, 2.5rem);
                --h2-size: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 1.75rem);
            }
        }

        @media (max-height: 600px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.5rem, 2.5vw, 1.5rem);
                --content-gap: clamp(0.3rem, 1vw, 0.75rem);
                --title-size: clamp(1.1rem, 4vw, 2rem);
                --body-size: clamp(0.7rem, 1.2vw, 0.95rem);
            }

            .nav-dots, .keyboard-hint, .decorative {
                display: none;
            }
        }

        @media (max-height: 500px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.4rem, 2vw, 1rem);
                --title-size: clamp(1rem, 3.5vw, 1.5rem);
                --h2-size: clamp(0.9rem, 2.5vw, 1.25rem);
                --body-size: clamp(0.65rem, 1vw, 0.85rem);
            }
        }

        @media (max-width: 600px) {
            :root {
                --title-size: clamp(1.25rem, 7vw, 2.5rem);
            }

            .grid {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            }

            .donut-layout {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            }

            .stats-grid {
                grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
            }
        }

        @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
            *, *::before, *::after {
                animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
                transition-duration: 0.2s !important;
            }

            html {
                scroll-behavior: auto;
            }
        }
    </style>

    <section class="slide title-slide" data-slide="0">

    <script>
        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE PRESENTATION CONTROLLER
           =========================================== */
        class SlidePresentation {
            constructor() {
                this.slides = document.querySelectorAll('.slide');
                this.currentSlide = 0;
                this.setupIntersectionObserver();
                this.setupKeyboardNav();
                this.setupTouchNav();
                this.setupProgressBar();
                this.setupNavDots();
                this.drawDonutChart();
                this.drawEngagementChart();
            }

            setupIntersectionObserver() {
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                            this.currentSlide = parseInt(entry.target.dataset.slide);
                            this.updateNavDots();
                            this.updateProgressBar();
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.4 });

                this.slides.forEach(slide => observer.observe(slide));
            }

            setupKeyboardNav() {
                document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                    if (e.key === 'ArrowDown' || e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'PageDown') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide + 1);
                    } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp' || e.key === 'PageUp') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide - 1);
                    } else if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') {
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide + 1);
                    } else if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') {
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide - 1);
                    } else if (e.key === 'Home') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(0);
                    } else if (e.key === 'End') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(this.slides.length - 1);
                    }
                });
            }

            setupTouchNav() {
                let touchStartY = 0;
                document.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
                    touchStartY = e.touches[0].clientY;
                }, { passive: true });

                document.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
                    const diff = touchStartY - e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
                    if (Math.abs(diff) > 50) {
                        if (diff > 0) this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide + 1);
                        else this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide - 1);
                    }
                }, { passive: true });
            }

            setupProgressBar() {
                this.progressBar = document.getElementById('progressBar');
                this.updateProgressBar();
            }

            updateProgressBar() {
                if (!this.progressBar) return;
                const pct = ((this.currentSlide + 1) / this.slides.length) * 100;
                this.progressBar.style.width = pct + '%';
            }

            setupNavDots() {
                const nav = document.getElementById('navDots');
                this.slides.forEach((_, i) => {
                    const dot = document.createElement('button');
                    dot.className = 'nav-dot' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
                    dot.setAttribute('aria-label', `Go to slide ${i + 1}`);
                    dot.addEventListener('click', () => this.goToSlide(i));
                    nav.appendChild(dot);
                });
                this.navDotEls = nav.querySelectorAll('.nav-dot');
            }

            updateNavDots() {
                this.navDotEls.forEach((dot, i) => {
                    dot.classList.toggle('active', i === this.currentSlide);
                });
            }

            goToSlide(index) {
                index = Math.max(0, Math.min(this.slides.length - 1, index));
                this.slides[index].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
            }

            /* ===========================================
               DONUT CHART (SVG)
               =========================================== */
            drawDonutChart() {
                const svg = document.getElementById('donutChart');
                if (!svg) return;

                const data = [
                    { label: 'Python', count: 7, color: '#3572A5' },
                    { label: 'TypeScript', count: 4, color: '#3178c6' },
                    { label: 'HTML', count: 2, color: '#e34c26' },
                    { label: 'Rust', count: 2, color: '#dea584' },
                    { label: 'Swift', count: 2, color: '#F05138' },
                    { label: 'Shell', count: 1, color: '#89e051' },
                    { label: 'Java', count: 1, color: '#b07219' },
                    { label: 'Unspecified', count: 1, color: '#555555' }
                ];

                const cx = 100, cy = 100, r = 70, innerR = 45;
                const total = data.reduce((s, d) => s + d.count, 0);
                const circumference = 2 * Math.PI * r;
                let offset = 0;

                /* Background ring */
                const bgCircle = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'circle');
                bgCircle.setAttribute('cx', cx);
                bgCircle.setAttribute('cy', cy);
                bgCircle.setAttribute('r', r);
                bgCircle.setAttribute('fill', 'none');
                bgCircle.setAttribute('stroke', 'rgba(255,255,255,0.05)');
                bgCircle.setAttribute('stroke-width', r - innerR);
                svg.appendChild(bgCircle);

                /* Segments */
                data.forEach(d => {
                    const pct = d.count / total;
                    const segLen = circumference * pct;
                    const gap = 2;

                    const circle = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'circle');
                    circle.setAttribute('cx', cx);
                    circle.setAttribute('cy', cy);
                    circle.setAttribute('r', r);
                    circle.setAttribute('fill', 'none');
                    circle.setAttribute('stroke', d.color);
                    circle.setAttribute('stroke-width', r - innerR);
                    circle.setAttribute('stroke-dasharray', `${segLen - gap} ${circumference - segLen + gap}`);
                    circle.setAttribute('stroke-dashoffset', calc(-1 * offset));
                    circle.setAttribute('transform', `rotate(-90 ${cx} ${cy})`);
                    circle.style.transition = 'stroke-dasharray 0.8s ease';
                    svg.appendChild(circle);

                    offset += segLen;
                });

                /* Center text */
                const centerText = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'text');
                centerText.setAttribute('x', cx);
                centerText.setAttribute('y', cy - 6);
                centerText.setAttribute('text-anchor', 'middle');
                centerText.setAttribute('fill', '#f0f4f8');
                centerText.setAttribute('font-family', 'Clash Display, sans-serif');
                centerText.setAttribute('font-size', '22');
                centerText.setAttribute('font-weight', '700');
                centerText.textContent = '20';
                svg.appendChild(centerText);

                const centerLabel = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'text');
                centerLabel.setAttribute('x', cx);
                centerLabel.setAttribute('y', cy + 14);
                centerLabel.setAttribute('text-anchor', 'middle');
                centerLabel.setAttribute('fill', '#8899aa');
                centerLabel.setAttribute('font-family', 'Satoshi, sans-serif');
                centerLabel.setAttribute('font-size', '10');
                centerLabel.textContent = 'repos';
                svg.appendChild(centerLabel);

                function calc(val) { return val; }
            }

            /* ===========================================
               ENGAGEMENT CHART (DOM-based grouped bars)
               =========================================== */
            drawEngagementChart() {
                const container = document.getElementById('engagementChart');
                if (!container) return;

                const repos = [
                    { name: 'hermes-agent', prs: 78, pushes: 42 },
                    { name: 'multica', prs: 7, pushes: 35 },
                    { name: 'oh-my-codex', prs: 2, pushes: 10 },
                    { name: 'rtk', prs: 5, pushes: 3 },
                    { name: 'graphify', prs: 5, pushes: 6 },
                    { name: 'opendataloader', prs: 1, pushes: 3 },
                    { name: 'reverse-SynthID', prs: 1, pushes: 2 },
                    { name: 'cc-switch', prs: 2, pushes: 2 },
                    { name: 'caveman', prs: 1, pushes: 1 },
                    { name: 'Recordly', prs: 1, pushes: 1 },
                    { name: 'DeepTutor', prs: 0, pushes: 2 },
                    { name: 'InstantSpace', prs: 0, pushes: 2 },
                    { name: '8 repos w/ 0 PRs', prs: 0, pushes: 0 }
                ];

                const maxVal = Math.max(...repos.map(r => Math.max(r.prs, r.pushes)));
                const chartHeight = 80; /* percentage of container */

                    bars.appendChild(pushesBar);

                    const label = document.createElement('div');
                    label.className = 'engage-label';
                    label.textContent = repo.name;

                    group.appendChild(bars);
                    group.appendChild(label);
                    container.appendChild(group);
                });

    <script>
        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE PRESENTATION CONTROLLER
           =========================================== */
        class SlidePresentation {
            constructor() {
                this.slides = document.querySelectorAll('.slide');
                this.currentSlide = 0;
                this.setupIntersectionObserver();
                this.setupKeyboardNav();
                this.setupTouchNav();
                this.setupProgressBar();
                this.setupNavDots();
                this.drawDonutChart();
                this.drawEngagementChart();
            }

            setupIntersectionObserver() {
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                            this.currentSlide = parseInt(entry.target.dataset.slide);
                            this.updateNavDots();
                            this.updateProgressBar();
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.4 });

                this.slides.forEach(slide => observer.observe(slide));
            }

            setupKeyboardNav() {
                document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                    if (e.key === 'ArrowDown' || e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'PageDown') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide + 1);
                    } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp' || e.key === 'PageUp') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide - 1);
                    } else if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') {
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide + 1);
                    } else if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') {
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide - 1);
                    } else if (e.key === 'Home') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(0);
                    } else if (e.key === 'End') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(this.slides.length - 1);
                    }
                });
            }

            setupTouchNav() {
                let touchStartY = 0;
                document.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
                    touchStartY = e.touches[0].clientY;
                }, { passive: true });

                document.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
                    const diff = touchStartY - e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
                    if (Math.abs(diff) > 50) {
                        if (diff > 0) this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide + 1);
                        else this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide - 1);
                    }
                }, { passive: true });
            }

            setupProgressBar() {
                this.progressBar = document.getElementById('progressBar');
                this.updateProgressBar();
            }

            updateProgressBar() {
                if (!this.progressBar) return;
                const pct = ((this.currentSlide + 1) / this.slides.length) * 100;
                this.progressBar.style.width = pct + '%';
            }

            setupNavDots() {
                const nav = document.getElementById('navDots');
                this.slides.forEach((_, i) => {
                    const dot = document.createElement('button');
                    dot.className = 'nav-dot' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
                    dot.setAttribute('aria-label', `Go to slide ${i + 1}`);
                    dot.addEventListener('click', () => this.goToSlide(i));
                    nav.appendChild(dot);
                });
                this.navDotEls = nav.querySelectorAll('.nav-dot');
            }

            updateNavDots() {
                this.navDotEls.forEach((dot, i) => {
                    dot.classList.toggle('active', i === this.currentSlide);
                });
            }

            goToSlide(index) {
                index = Math.max(0, Math.min(this.slides.length - 1, index));
                this.slides[index].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
            }

            /* ===========================================
               DONUT CHART (SVG)
               =========================================== */
            drawDonutChart() {
                const svg = document.getElementById('donutChart');
                if (!svg) return;

                const data = [
                    { label: 'Python', count: 7, color: '#3572A5' },
                    { label: 'TypeScript', count: 4, color: '#3178c6' },
                    { label: 'HTML', count: 2, color: '#e34c26' },
                    { label: 'Rust', count: 2, color: '#dea584' },
                    { label: 'Swift', count: 2, color: '#F05138' },
                    { label: 'Shell', count: 1, color: '#89e051' },
                    { label: 'Java', count: 1, color: '#b07219' },
                    { label: 'Unspecified', count: 1, color: '#555555' }
                ];

                const cx = 100, cy = 100, r = 70, innerR = 45;
                const total = data.reduce((s, d) => s + d.count, 0);
                const circumference = 2 * Math.PI * r;
                let offset = 0;

                /* Background ring */
                const bgCircle = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'circle');
                bgCircle.setAttribute('cx', cx);
                bgCircle.setAttribute('cy', cy);
                bgCircle.setAttribute('r', r);
                bgCircle.setAttribute('fill', 'none');
                bgCircle.setAttribute('stroke', 'rgba(255,255,255,0.05)');
                bgCircle.setAttribute('stroke-width', r - innerR);
                svg.appendChild(bgCircle);

                /* Segments */
                data.forEach(d => {
                    const pct = d.count / total;
                    const segLen = circumference * pct;
                    const gap = 2;

                    const circle = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'circle');
                    circle.setAttribute('cx', cx);
                    circle.setAttribute('cy', cy);
                    circle.setAttribute('r', r);
                    circle.setAttribute('fill', 'none');
                    circle.setAttribute('stroke', d.color);
                    circle.setAttribute('stroke-width', r - innerR);
                    circle.setAttribute('stroke-dasharray', `${segLen - gap} ${circumference - segLen + gap}`);
                    circle.setAttribute('stroke-dashoffset', calc(-1 * offset));
                    circle.setAttribute('transform', `rotate(-90 ${cx} ${cy})`);
                    circle.style.transition = 'stroke-dasharray 0.8s ease';
                    svg.appendChild(circle);

                    offset += segLen;
                });

                /* Center text */
                const centerText = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'text');
                centerText.setAttribute('x', cx);
                centerText.setAttribute('y', cy - 6);
                centerText.setAttribute('text-anchor', 'middle');
                centerText.setAttribute('fill', '#f0f4f8');
                centerText.setAttribute('font-family', 'Clash Display, sans-serif');
                centerText.setAttribute('font-size', '22');
                centerText.setAttribute('font-weight', '700');
                centerText.textContent = '20';
                svg.appendChild(centerText);

                const centerLabel = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'text');
                centerLabel.setAttribute('x', cx);
                centerLabel.setAttribute('y', cy + 14);
                centerLabel.setAttribute('text-anchor', 'middle');
                centerLabel.setAttribute('fill', '#8899aa');
                centerLabel.setAttribute('font-family', 'Satoshi, sans-serif');
                centerLabel.setAttribute('font-size', '10');
                centerLabel.textContent = 'repos';
                svg.appendChild(centerLabel);

                function calc(val) { return val; }
            }

            /* ===========================================
               ENGAGEMENT CHART (DOM-based grouped bars)
               =========================================== */
            drawEngagementChart() {
                const container = document.getElementById('engagementChart');
                if (!container) return;

                const repos = [
                    { name: 'hermes-agent', prs: 78, pushes: 42 },
                    { name: 'multica', prs: 7, pushes: 35 },
                    { name: 'oh-my-codex', prs: 2, pushes: 10 },
                    { name: 'rtk', prs: 5, pushes: 3 },
                    { name: 'graphify', prs: 5, pushes: 6 },
                    { name: 'opendataloader', prs: 1, pushes: 3 },
                    { name: 'reverse-SynthID', prs: 1, pushes: 2 },
                    { name: 'cc-switch', prs: 2, pushes: 2 },
                    { name: 'caveman', prs: 1, pushes: 1 },
                    { name: 'Recordly', prs: 1, pushes: 1 },
                    { name: 'DeepTutor', prs: 0, pushes: 2 },
                    { name: 'InstantSpace', prs: 0, pushes: 2 },
                    { name: '8 repos w/ 0 PRs', prs: 0, pushes: 0 }
                ];

                const maxVal = Math.max(...repos.map(r => Math.max(r.prs, r.pushes)));
                const chartHeight = 80; /* percentage of container */

                repos.forEach((repo, i) => {
                    const group = document.createElement('div');
                    group.className = 'engage-group';

                    const bars = document.createElement('div');
                    bars.className = 'engage-bars';

                    const prsH = repo.prs > 0 ? Math.max(3, (repo.prs / maxVal) * chartHeight) : 0;
                    const pushesH = repo.pushes > 0 ? Math.max(3, (repo.pushes / maxVal) * chartHeight) : 0;

                    const prsBar = document.createElement('div');
                    prsBar.className = 'engage-bar prs';
                    prsBar.style.height = prsH + '%';
                    prsBar.title = `${repo.prs} PRs`;

                    const pushesBar = document.createElement('div');
                    pushesBar.className = 'engage-bar pushes';
                    pushesBar.style.height = pushesH + '%';
                    pushesBar.title = `${repo.pushes} pushes`;

                    bars.appendChild(prsBar);
                    bars.appendChild(pushesBar);

                    const label = document.createElement('div');
                    label.className = 'engage-label';
                    label.textContent = repo.name;

                    group.appendChild(bars);
                    group.appendChild(label);
                    container.appendChild(group);
                });
            }
        }

        new SlidePresentation();
    </script>
</body>

    <script>
        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE PRESENTATION CONTROLLER
           =========================================== */
        class SlidePresentation {
            constructor() {
                this.slides = document.querySelectorAll('.slide');
                this.currentSlide = 0;
                this.setupIntersectionObserver();
                this.setupKeyboardNav();
                this.setupTouchNav();
                this.setupProgressBar();
                this.setupNavDots();
                this.drawDonutChart();
                this.drawEngagementChart();
            }

            setupIntersectionObserver() {
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                            this.currentSlide = parseInt(entry.target.dataset.slide);
                            this.updateNavDots();
                            this.updateProgressBar();
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.4 });

                this.slides.forEach(slide => observer.observe(slide));
            }

            setupKeyboardNav() {
                document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                    if (e.key === 'ArrowDown' || e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'PageDown') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide + 1);
                    } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp' || e.key === 'PageUp') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide - 1);
                    } else if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') {
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide + 1);
                    } else if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') {
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide - 1);
                    } else if (e.key === 'Home') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(0);
                    } else if (e.key === 'End') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(this.slides.length - 1);
                    }
                });
            }

            setupTouchNav() {
                let touchStartY = 0;
                document.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
                    touchStartY = e.touches[0].clientY;
                }, { passive: true });

                document.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
                    const diff = touchStartY - e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
                    if (Math.abs(diff) > 50) {
                        if (diff > 0) this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide + 1);
                        else this.goToSlide(this.currentSlide - 1);
                    }
                }, { passive: true });
            }

            setupProgressBar() {
                this.progressBar = document.getElementById('progressBar');
                this.updateProgressBar();
            }

            updateProgressBar() {
                if (!this.progressBar) return;
                const pct = ((this.currentSlide + 1) / this.slides.length) * 100;
                this.progressBar.style.width = pct + '%';
            }

            setupNavDots() {
                const nav = document.getElementById('navDots');
                this.slides.forEach((_, i) => {
                    const dot = document.createElement('button');
                    dot.className = 'nav-dot' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
                    dot.setAttribute('aria-label', `Go to slide ${i + 1}`);
                    dot.addEventListener('click', () => this.goToSlide(i));
                    nav.appendChild(dot);
                });
                this.navDotEls = nav.querySelectorAll('.nav-dot');
            }

            updateNavDots() {
                this.navDotEls.forEach((dot, i) => {
                    dot.classList.toggle('active', i === this.currentSlide);
                });
            }

            goToSlide(index) {
                index = Math.max(0, Math.min(this.slides.length - 1, index));
                this.slides[index].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
            }

            /* ===========================================
               DONUT CHART (SVG)
               =========================================== */
            drawDonutChart() {
                const svg = document.getElementById('donutChart');
                if (!svg) return;

                const data = [
                    { label: 'Python', count: 7, color: '#3572A5' },
                    { label: 'TypeScript', count: 4, color: '#3178c6' },
                    { label: 'HTML', count: 2, color: '#e34c26' },
                    { label: 'Rust', count: 2, color: '#dea584' },
                    { label: 'Swift', count: 2, color: '#F05138' },
                    { label: 'Shell', count: 1, color: '#89e051' },
                    { label: 'Java', count: 1, color: '#b07219' },
                    { label: 'Unspecified', count: 1, color: '#555555' }
                ];

                const cx = 100, cy = 100, r = 70, innerR = 45;
                const total = data.reduce((s, d) => s + d.count, 0);
                const circumference = 2 * Math.PI * r;
                let offset = 0;

                /* Background ring */
                const bgCircle = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'circle');
                bgCircle.setAttribute('cx', cx);
                bgCircle.setAttribute('cy', cy);
                bgCircle.setAttribute('r', r);
                bgCircle.setAttribute('fill', 'none');
                bgCircle.setAttribute('stroke', 'rgba(255,255,255,0.05)');
                bgCircle.setAttribute('stroke-width', r - innerR);
                svg.appendChild(bgCircle);

                /* Segments */
                data.forEach(d => {
                    const pct = d.count / total;
                    const segLen = circumference * pct;
                    const gap = 2;

                    const circle = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'circle');
                    circle.setAttribute('cx', cx);
                    circle.setAttribute('cy', cy);
                    circle.setAttribute('r', r);
                    circle.setAttribute('fill', 'none');
                    circle.setAttribute('stroke', d.color);
                    circle.setAttribute('stroke-width', r - innerR);
                    circle.setAttribute('stroke-dasharray', `${segLen - gap} ${circumference - segLen + gap}`);
                    circle.setAttribute('stroke-dashoffset', calc(-1 * offset));
                    circle.setAttribute('transform', `rotate(-90 ${cx} ${cy})`);
                    circle.style.transition = 'stroke-dasharray 0.8s ease';
                    svg.appendChild(circle);

                    offset += segLen;
                });

                /* Center text */
                const centerText = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'text');
                centerText.setAttribute('x', cx);
                centerText.setAttribute('y', cy - 6);
                centerText.setAttribute('text-anchor', 'middle');
                centerText.setAttribute('fill', '#f0f4f8');
                centerText.setAttribute('font-family', 'Clash Display, sans-serif');
                centerText.setAttribute('font-size', '22');
                centerText.setAttribute('font-weight', '700');
                centerText.textContent = '20';
                svg.appendChild(centerText);

                const centerLabel = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'text');
                centerLabel.setAttribute('x', cx);
                centerLabel.setAttribute('y', cy + 14);
                centerLabel.setAttribute('text-anchor', 'middle');
                centerLabel.setAttribute('fill', '#8899aa');
                centerLabel.setAttribute('font-family', 'Satoshi, sans-serif');
                centerLabel.setAttribute('font-size', '10');
                centerLabel.textContent = 'repos';
                svg.appendChild(centerLabel);

                function calc(val) { return val; }
            }

            /* ===========================================
               ENGAGEMENT CHART (DOM-based grouped bars)
               =========================================== */
            drawEngagementChart() {
                const container = document.getElementById('engagementChart');
                if (!container) return;

                const repos = [
                    { name: 'hermes-agent', prs: 78, pushes: 42 },
                    { name: 'multica', prs: 7, pushes: 35 },
                    { name: 'oh-my-codex', prs: 2, pushes: 10 },
                    { name: 'rtk', prs: 5, pushes: 3 },
                    { name: 'graphify', prs: 5, pushes: 6 },
                    { name: 'opendataloader', prs: 1, pushes: 3 },
                    { name: 'reverse-SynthID', prs: 1, pushes: 2 },
                    { name: 'cc-switch', prs: 2, pushes: 2 },
                    { name: 'caveman', prs: 1, pushes: 1 },
                    { name: 'Recordly', prs: 1, pushes: 1 },
                    { name: 'DeepTutor', prs: 0, pushes: 2 },
                    { name: 'InstantSpace', prs: 0, pushes: 2 },
                    { name: '8 repos w/ 0 PRs', prs: 0, pushes: 0 }
                ];

                const maxVal = Math.max(...repos.map(r => Math.max(r.prs, r.pushes)));
                const chartHeight = 80; /* percentage of container */

                repos.forEach((repo, i) => {
                    const group = document.createElement('div');
                    group.className = 'engage-group';

                    const bars = document.createElement('div');
                    bars.className = 'engage-bars';

                    const prsH = repo.prs > 0 ? Math.max(3, (repo.prs / maxVal) * chartHeight) : 0;
                    const pushesH = repo.pushes > 0 ? Math.max(3, (repo.pushes / maxVal) * chartHeight) : 0;

                    const prsBar = document.createElement('div');
                    prsBar.className = 'engage-bar prs';
                    prsBar.style.height = prsH + '%';
                    prsBar.title = `${repo.prs} PRs`;

                    const pushesBar = document.createElement('div');
                    pushesBar.className = 'engage-bar pushes';
                    pushesBar.style.height = pushesH + '%';
                    pushesBar.title = `${repo.pushes} pushes`;

                    bars.appendChild(prsBar);
                    bars.appendChild(pushesBar);

                    const label = document.createElement('div');
                    label.className = 'engage-label';
                    label.textContent = repo.name;

                    group.appendChild(bars);
                    group.appendChild(label);
                    container.appendChild(group);
                });
            }
        }

        new SlidePresentation();
    </script>
</body>
</html>

6	assemble the images into a 16:9 PPTX via python-pptx.
7	
8	A local HTTP server is started so Google Fonts and relative asset paths load

11	Usage:
12	    python html_to_pptx.py <input.html> <output.pptx> [--width 1920] [--height 1080]

33	def _make_screenshot_script(url: str, out_dir: str, width: int, height: int) -> str:
34	    """Return a Node.js script that navigates and screenshots each slide."""
35	    selectors_js = ", ".join(f'"{s}"' for s in SLIDE_SELECTORS)
36	    return f"""\
37	const {{ chromium }} = require('playwright');
38	
39	(async () => {{
40	    const browser = await chromium.launch({{ executablePath: process.env.PLAYWRIGHT_CHROMIUM_EXECUTABLE_PATH || undefined }});
41	    const page = await browser.newPage();
42	    await page.setViewportSize({{ width: {width}, height: {height} }});
43	    await page.goto('{url}', {{ waitUntil: 'networkidle' }});
44	
45	    // --- Count slides using DOM selectors ---
46	    const selectors = [{selectors_js}];
47	    let slideCount = 0;
48	    for (const sel of selectors) {{
49	        slideCount = await page.$$eval(sel, els => els.length);
50	        if (slideCount > 0) break;
51	    }}
52	
53	    // Fallback: treat the whole page as 1 slide
54	    if (slideCount === 0) slideCount = 1;
55	
56	    // Reasonable upper bound to prevent infinite loops
57	    if (slideCount > 100) slideCount = 100;
58	
59	    // --- Capture slide 1 (already visible on load) ---
60	    // Wait for entrance animations to settle
61	    await page.waitForTimeout(500);
62	    await page.screenshot({{ path: `{out_dir}/slide_001.png` }});
63	
64	    // --- Navigate through remaining slides via ArrowRight ---
65	    // We track visual changes to detect when navigation has no more effect
66	    // (i.e. we've passed the last slide).
67	    let prevPath = `{out_dir}/slide_001.png`;
68	    let captured = 1;
69	
70	    for (let i = 2; i <= slideCount; i++) {{
71	        await page.keyboard.press('ArrowRight');
72	        // Wait for transition animation to complete
73	        await page.waitForTimeout(600);
74	
75	        const idx = String(i).padStart(3, '0');
76	        const path = `{out_dir}/slide_${{idx}}.png`;
77	        await page.screenshot({{ path }});
78	        captured++;
79	    }}
80	
81	    console.log(JSON.stringify({{ captured }}));
82	    await browser.close();
83	}})();
84	"""
85	
86	
87	def _deduplicate_slides(image_dir: Path) -> list[Path]:
88	    """Remove trailing duplicate screenshots (navigation past last slide).
89	
90	    Some presentations keep showing the last slide when you press ArrowRight
91	    beyond the end.  We detect this by comparing file sizes + pixel samples.
92	    """
93	    pngs = sorted(image_dir.glob("slide_*.png"))
94	    if len(pngs) <= 1:
95	        return pngs
96	
97	    unique: list[Path] = [pngs[0]]
98	    prev_img = Image.open(pngs[0])
99	
100	    for png in pngs[1:]:
101	        curr_img = Image.open(png)
102	        # Quick check: compare a grid of sample pixels
103	        is_dup = True
104	        for x_frac in (0.25, 0.5, 0.75):
105	            for y_frac in (0.25, 0.5, 0.75):
106	                px = int(curr_img.width * x_frac)
107	                py = int(curr_img.height * y_frac)
108	                if curr_img.getpixel((px, py)) != prev_img.getpixel((px, py)):
109	                    is_dup = False
110	                    break
111	            if not is_dup:
112	                break
113	
114	        if not is_dup:
115	            unique.append(png)
116	            prev_img = curr_img
117	        else:
118	            # Once we hit a duplicate, stop — remaining are likely all dupes
119	            break
120	
121	    return unique
122	
123	
124	def _start_http_server(directory: Path, port: int = 0):
125	    """Start a background HTTP server serving *directory*. Returns (server, port)."""
126	    handler = http.server.SimpleHTTPRequestHandler
127	    server = http.server.HTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", port), lambda *a, **kw: handler(*a, directory=str(directory), **kw))
128	    actual_port = server.server_address[1]
129	    thread = threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True)
130	    thread.start()
131	    return server, actual_port
132	
133	
134	def screenshot_slides(html_path: Path, out_dir: Path, width: int, height: int) -> list[Path]:
135	    """Run Playwright to capture per-slide PNGs. Returns deduplicated list."""
136	    # Serve via HTTP so Google Fonts and relative assets load correctly
137	    serve_dir = html_path.resolve().parent
138	    server, port = _start_http_server(serve_dir)
139	    url = f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}/{html_path.resolve().name}"
140	
141	    try:
142	        script = _make_screenshot_script(url, str(out_dir), width, height)
143	        script_file = out_dir / "_capture.cjs"
144	        script_file.write_text(script)
145	
146	        env = os.environ.copy()
147	        env.setdefault("NODE_PATH", "/usr/local/lib/node_modules:/app/node_modules")
148	        env.setdefault("PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH", "/ms-playwright")
149	        env.setdefault("PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_BROWSER_DOWNLOAD", "1")
150	        result = subprocess.run(
151	            ["node", str(script_file)],
152	            capture_output=True,
153	            text=True,
154	            timeout=180,
155	            env=env,
156	        )
157	        if result.returncode != 0:
158	            print(f"Playwright stderr:\n{result.stderr}", file=sys.stderr)
159	            raise RuntimeError(f"Screenshot script failed (exit {result.returncode})")
160	    finally:
161	        server.shutdown()
162	
163	    pngs = _deduplicate_slides(out_dir)
164	    if not pngs:
165	        raise RuntimeError("No slide screenshots produced")
166	    return pngs
167	
168	
169	def assemble_pptx(slide_images: list[Path], output_path: Path) -> None:
170	    """Pack slide images into a standard 16:9 PPTX."""
171	    prs = Presentation()
172	    # Standard 16:9 dimensions
173	    prs.slide_width = Emu(12192000)   # 13.333 inches
174	    prs.slide_height = Emu(6858000)   # 7.5 inches
175	
176	    blank_layout = prs.slide_layouts[6]  # blank layout
177	
178	    for img_path in slide_images:
179	        slide = prs.slides.add_slide(blank_layout)
180	        slide.shapes.add_picture(
181	            str(img_path),
182	            left=Emu(0),
183	            top=Emu(0),
184	            width=prs.slide_width,
185	            height=prs.slide_height,
186	        )
187	
188	    prs.save(str(output_path))
189	
190	
191	def main():
192	    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Convert HTML presentation to PPTX via screenshots")
193	    parser.add_argument("input_html", help="Path to the single-file HTML presentation")
194	    parser.add_argument("output_pptx", help="Output PPTX path")
195	    parser.add_argument("--width", type=int, default=1920, help="Viewport width (default 1920)")
196	    parser.add_argument("--height", type=int, default=1080, help="Viewport height (default 1080)")
197	    args = parser.parse_args()
198	
199	    html_path = Path(args.input_html).resolve()
200	    output_path = Path(args.output_pptx).resolve()
201	
202	    if not html_path.exists():
203	        raise FileNotFoundError(f"Input HTML not found: {html_path}")
204	
205	    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="slides_") as tmp:
206	        tmp_dir = Path(tmp)
207	        print(f"Capturing slides from {html_path} ...")
208	        images = screenshot_slides(html_path, tmp_dir, args.width, args.height)
209	        print(f"Captured {len(images)} unique slide(s), assembling PPTX ...")
210	        assemble_pptx(images, output_path)
211	        print(f"Done → {output_path}")
212	
213	
214	if __name__ == "__main__":
215	    main()

87	def _deduplicate_slides(image_dir: Path) -> list[Path]:
88	    """Remove trailing duplicate screenshots (navigation past last slide).
89	
90	    Some presentations keep showing the last slide when you press ArrowRight
91	    beyond the end.  We detect this by comparing file sizes + pixel samples.
92	    """
93	    pngs = sorted(image_dir.glob("slide_*.png"))
94	    if len(pngs) <= 1:
95	        return pngs
96	
97	    unique: list[Path] = [pngs[0]]
98	    prev_img = Image.open(pngs[0])
99	
100	    for png in pngs[1:]:
101	        curr_img = Image.open(png)
102	        # Quick check: compare a grid of sample pixels
103	        is_dup = True
104	        for x_frac in (0.25, 0.5, 0.75):
105	            for y_frac in (0.25, 0.5, 0.75):
106	                px = int(curr_img.width * x_frac)
107	                py = int(curr_img.height * y_frac)
108	                if curr_img.getpixel((px, py)) != prev_img.getpixel((px, py)):
109	                    is_dup = False
110	                    break
111	            if not is_dup:
112	                break
113	
114	        if not is_dup:
115	            unique.append(png)
116	            prev_img = curr_img
117	        else:
118	            # Once we hit a duplicate, stop — remaining are likely all dupes
119	            break
120	
121	    return unique

124	def _start_http_server(directory: Path, port: int = 0):
125	    """Start a background HTTP server serving *directory*. Returns (server, port)."""
126	    handler = http.server.SimpleHTTPRequestHandler
127	    server = http.server.HTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", port), lambda *a, **kw: handler(*a, directory=str(directory), **kw))
128	    actual_port = server.server_address[1]
129	    thread = threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True)
130	    thread.start()
131	    return server, actual_port

134	def screenshot_slides(html_path: Path, out_dir: Path, width: int, height: int) -> list[Path]:
135	    """Run Playwright to capture per-slide PNGs. Returns deduplicated list."""
136	    # Serve via HTTP so Google Fonts and relative assets load correctly
137	    serve_dir = html_path.resolve().parent
138	    server, port = _start_http_server(serve_dir)
139	    url = f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}/{html_path.resolve().name}"
140	
141	    try:
142	        script = _make_screenshot_script(url, str(out_dir), width, height)
143	        script_file = out_dir / "_capture.cjs"
144	        script_file.write_text(script)
145	
146	        env = os.environ.copy()
147	        env.setdefault("NODE_PATH", "/usr/local/lib/node_modules:/app/node_modules")
148	        env.setdefault("PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH", "/ms-playwright")
149	        env.setdefault("PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_BROWSER_DOWNLOAD", "1")
150	        result = subprocess.run(
151	            ["node", str(script_file)],
152	            capture_output=True,
153	            text=True,
154	            timeout=180,
155	            env=env,

170	    """Pack slide images into a standard 16:9 PPTX."""
171	    prs = Presentation()
172	    # Standard 16:9 dimensions
173	    prs.slide_width = Emu(12192000)   # 13.333 inches
174	    prs.slide_height = Emu(6858000)   # 7.5 inches
175	
176	    blank_layout = prs.slide_layouts[6]  # blank layout
177	
178	    for img_path in slide_images:
179	        slide = prs.slides.add_slide(blank_layout)
180	        slide.shapes.add_picture(
181	            str(img_path),
182	            left=Emu(0),
183	            top=Emu(0),
184	            width=prs.slide_width,
185	            height=prs.slide_height,
186	        )
187	
188	    prs.save(str(output_path))

195	    parser.add_argument("--width", type=int, default=1920, help="Viewport width (default 1920)")
196	    parser.add_argument("--height", type=int, default=1080, help="Viewport height (default 1080)")
